sloka: स उपसर्गाम् यथा सिद्धिम् बुद्धिम् सकलुषाम् इव ।अभूतेन अपवादेन कीर्तिम् निपतिताम् इव ॥५-१५-३४॥
transliteration: sa upasargām yathā siddhim buddhim sakaluṣām iva ।abhūtena apavādena kīrtim nipatitām iva ॥5-15-34॥

translations.english: She appeared like fame besmirched by false allegation. She was pained by the obstruction to meet Rama and emaciated by abduction.
